title: Spyglass: Unleashing Enhanced Insights
summary: Experience the full power of Spyglass, now widely available to help you uncover deeper insights and make smarter decisions.

title: Powerful File Management & Display Options
summary: Now you can effortlessly manage all your embedded files, upload new ones, and customize their appearance directly within the editor.

title: Interactive Public Roadmap
summary: We've launched an interactive public roadmap, providing a clear view of our progress, what's coming next, and our exciting future plans.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: We've made checkboxes easier to use, drag, and visually appealing, enhancing your editing experience with a more seamless and modern interface.

title: Improved Real-time Collaboration
summary: We've significantly enhanced our editor to make real-time collaboration smoother and more intuitive for teams.

title: Enhanced Collaboration and Discovery
summary: Effortlessly find and collaborate on shared ideas and quests with improved visibility and access to all relevant items, making teamwork more intuitive and efficient.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: We are thrilled to announce that Noeko's codebase is now open source, empowering our community with greater control, direct involvement, and full transparency in our project's exciting future.

title: Global Language Support
summary: We are thrilled to introduce comprehensive support for international languages, enabling Noeko to connect with users across the globe.

title: Elevated Theme Gallery & Fresh Styles
summary: We're refining our existing themes to deliver a more polished and cohesive visual experience, alongside introducing an array of brand-new themes to vastly expand your personalization choices.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Explorer
summary: Transform your knowledge exploration with a dynamic Constellation view, now featuring powerful filtering by tags and time, alongside enhanced visibility into your shared content and connections.

title: Advanced Search & Custom Collections
summary: Discover, filter, and save your most relevant information with powerful new search capabilities and custom collections, keeping your knowledge perfectly organized and accessible.

title: Smarter Ways to Connect Your Ideas
summary: Experience enhanced control over how your linked notes appear, empowering you to structure your thoughts and information in a way that truly reflects your unique thinking process.

title: Noeko's Public Launch: Self-Hosted & Premium Features
summary: We're preparing Noeko for its highly anticipated public launch, giving you the power to choose between flexible self-hosting or convenient cloud-hosted solutions, complete with valuable premium features.

title: Always-Accurate Time-Based Greetings
summary: Enjoy a more personalized experience with greetings that precisely match the time of day, ensuring a warm welcome whenever you log in.

title: Quick Actions for Tagged Items
summary: Effortlessly organize your content by allowing you to swiftly remove items from tags and perform other useful actions directly from any tag's list view.

title: Bring All Your Content Together
summary: Seamlessly integrate and interact with a vast array of content, from YouTube videos and websites to text files, to centralize all your valuable information in one place.
